farmers.name: Mang Juan Dela Cruz
farmers.storyQuote: Ang tunay na yaman ng lupa ay hindi lamang sa dami ng ani, kundi sa pag-aalaga sa kalikasan para sa susunod na henerasyon ng kabataang Pilipino.
farmers.fullBiography: Nagsimula si Mang Juan noong 1984 sa 2-ektaryang taniman ng kape at lansones sa paanan ng Mount Maculot. Sa apat na dekadang pagtitiyaga, pinangunahan niya ang paggamit ng vermiculture, rainwater retention canals, at natural bee pollinator sanctuaries. Ngayon, nagbibigay ang Sunnyvale Farm ng regular na kabuhayan sa higit 24 na pamilyang magsasaka at tumatanggap ng mga eco-tourists upang ituro ang tunay na diwa ng Batangueño farming.
farmers.farmingPhilosophy: Regenerative soil stewardship: feed the microorganisms first, and the soil will feed the community abundantly without chemicals.
certifications: Bureau of Plant Industry GAP Certified

farmers.name: Nanay Elena Soriano
farmers.roleTitle: Highland Organic Pioneer & Women Farmers Leader
farmers.farmName: Benguet Berry Haven & Highland Mist Sanctuary
farmers.storyQuote: Sa bawat umagang nababalot ng hamog ang La Trinidad, bawat punla ng strawberry at kape ay inaalagaan naming parang sariling anak nang walang nakalalasong kemikal.
farmers.fullBiography: Tubong Benguet si Nanay Elena at namulat sa tradisyunal na pagtatanim sa bulubundukin ng Cordillera. Noong dekada 90, pinasimulan niya ang pag-aalis ng mga kemikal na pestisidyo pabor sa pine needle composting at botanical sprays. Bilang pangulo ng La Trinidad Women Agrarian Cooperative, matagumpay niyang ikinonekta ang mga turista at direct consumers sa kanilang aning strawberry at kape, kaya napanatili ang patas na presyo para sa kababaihang magsasaka.
farmers.farmingPhilosophy: High-altitude organic balance: working in harmony with mountain fog, spring waters, and ancestral terracing wisdom.

farmers.name: Mang Rigor Rodriguez
farmers.roleTitle: Veteran Mango Arborist & Heirloom Seed Steward
farmers.storyQuote: Ang lupang ipinamana sa atin ng ating mga ninuno ay may sagradong tungkuling pakainin nang malinis at masustansya ang pamilyang Pilipino.
farmers.fullBiography: Si Mang Rigor ay kilala sa buong Katagalugan sa pagpapanatili ng natural na paraan ng pamumunga ng manggang kalabaw nang hindi gumagamit ng calcium carbide o synthetic ripeners. Ang kanyang sakahan ay tahanan din ng mga heirloom na uri ng palay tulad ng Dinorado at Milagrosa. Tumatanggap siya ng mga mag-aaral ng agrikultura upang ituro ang sining ng tree grafting, organic seed storage, at rice field micro-ecosystems.
farmers.farmingPhilosophy: Ancestral inheritance: trees that were planted by grandfathers must be preserved with devotion for great-grandchildren.

farmers.name: Tatay Ramon Alcantara
farmers.storyQuote: Ang bulkanikong lupa ng Bukidnon ay biyayang dapat pangalagaan. Sa bawat pinya at dragonfruit na inyong kinakain, sinusuportahan ninyo ang aming katutubong watershed.
farmers.fullBiography: Lumaki si Tatay Ramon sa malawak na kapatagan ng Bukidnon kung saan nagtatagpo ang malamig na simoy ng bundok at matabang lupang bulkaniko. Nang makita ang pinsala ng soil erosion sa mga kalapit na bayan, sinimulan niya ang vetiver contour hedgerows at diversified agroforestry. Ngayon, ang kanyang plantasyon ay dinadayo ng mga turista na nagnanais maranasan ang pamimitas ng pinakamatamis na golden queen pineapples at pulang dragonfruit.
farmers.farmingPhilosophy: Watershed-first agriculture: what happens in our mountain soils directly protects the rivers that sustain hundreds of towns below.

farmers.name: Ka Luming Mendoza
farmers.storyQuote: Ang tsokolate ng Pilipinas ay may world-class na sarap kung nagmumula sa minamahal at protektadong shaded agroforest.
farmers.fullBiography: Si Ka Luming ay isa sa mga nangungunang babaeng tagapagtaguyod ng Philippine Criollo and Trinitario cacao. Sa kanyang 6-ektaryang sakahan sa paanan ng Mount Apo, ang mga puno ng cacao ay sumisilong sa ilalim ng matatayog na puno ng narra, saging, at mangosteen. Ang kanyang artisan tablea at single-origin chocolates ay umani ng pagkilala sa lokal at pandaigdigang eksena, at nagbibigay ng pangkabuhayang pagsasanay sa higit 30 kababaihan sa kanilang barangay.
farmers.farmingPhilosophy: Canopy ecology: the greatest cocoa flavor comes from the complexity of living inside a true tropical forest.

tours.name: Sunnyvale Farm Heritage Agro-Trail
tours.description: Tucked inside the fertile volcanic hills of Bauan, Sunnyvale Farm is a multi-generational eco-estate famous for ancient Lanzones, Rambutan, and Carabao mango groves. Visitors embark on peaceful shaded trails through 40-year-old fruit canopies, taste fresh coconut water harvested right before your eyes, and savor a traditional Batangueño farm lunch cooked over open wood fire.

tours.name: Golden Sunflower & Honeycomb Sanctuary
tours.description: A breathtaking 6-hectare botanical sanctuary blanketed in over 50,000 golden blooming sunflowers. Designed as an educational haven for native pollinators and families, guests explore elevated bamboo walkways, interact with gentle stingless bees inside mesh observation huts, and sample pure raw comb honey with native herbal teas.

tours.name: Laurel Ridge Taal Overlook & Cacao Forest
tours.description: Perched high along the cool ridges overlooking Taal Lake and volcanic hills, Laurel View Farm combines agro-forestry with artisanal chocolate craft. Walk through shaded cacao trees, harvest purple cacao pods, roast fermented beans in traditional copper skillets, and press your own organic tablea chocolate cake.

tours.name: Banaue Ancestral Rice Terraces Cultural Trail
tours.description: A monumental cultural expedition along 2,000-year-old stone terrace walls hand-built by ancient Cordillera tribes. Guided by native elder farmers, trekkers step along cascading water canals, learn the sacred cultivation rituals of heirloom Tinawon red rice, and witness traditional back-strap loom weaving.

tours.name: Riverside Bamboo Agritrail & Waterway Haven
tours.description: Nestled along natural freshwater springs, this tranquil agro-park features floating bamboo bridges, lush riverbanks, and fragrant citrus canopies. Hop aboard bamboo balsa rafts, hand-feed native river carps, harvest fragrant Calamansi and Dalandan, and relax under giant bamboo clusters.

tours.name: Green Valley Herbal Sanctuary & Organic Farm
tours.description: An oasis of wellness and agro-ecology at the foot of Mount Arayat. Explore certified organic plots cultivating lemongrass, blue ternatea, gotu kola, and stevia. Hand-pick fresh herbs to blend your own artisan wellness tisanes and enjoy freshly harvested farm salads.

fruitPicking.title: Sweet Dalanghita & Valencia Orange Orchard Harvest
fruitPicking.description: Wander through sun-drenched Batangas citrus groves where low-hanging branches are heavy with sweet Valencia oranges and native green Dalanghita. Receive wooden harvest shears and a woven basket to pick the juiciest fruits directly off the tree with guidance from our veteran orchardists.

fruitPicking.title: Highland Sweet Strawberry Harvest Festival
fruitPicking.description: Experience the iconic highland morning harvest in the crisp, fog-kissed mountain air of La Trinidad. Handpick bright crimson, perfectly ripe strawberries straight from organic straw-mulched garden beds. Includes a woven keepsake basket and sample tasting of freshly stirred strawberry jam.

fruitPicking.title: Golden Carabao Mango Tree-to-Basket Harvest
fruitPicking.description: Harvest the world's sweetest mangoes! Learn traditional bamboo pole harvesting (panungkit with woven cloth pouches) alongside multi-generation mango growers. Pick sun-ripened golden Carabao mangoes directly from 50-year-old heritage canopies with zero chemical carbide treatment.

fruitPicking.title: Radiant Magenta Dragon Fruit & Passionfruit Trellis
fruitPicking.description: Stroll along towering concrete trellis rows laden with radiant magenta and snowy-white dragonfruits. Clip the ripe, spiny fruit directly from cactus pads with our protective gloves and shears, followed by a chilled glass of fresh dragonfruit-lime juice at the ridge overlook deck.

fruitPicking.title: Sweet Rambutan & Lanzones Cluster Harvest
fruitPicking.description: Step into shaded canopy groves where trees are bursting with bright red, hairy sweet Rambutan and translucent sweet Paete Lanzones clusters. Use wooden orchard steps to gently clip thick clusters right into your woven basket while sampling sweet, juicy pulp on the spot.

fruitPicking.title: Bountiful Golden Papaya & Guava Grove Harvest
fruitPicking.description: Experience the lush upland groves of Silang, Cavite. Pluck fragrant ripe Red Lady papayas and sweet pink guavas directly from gently sloping garden rows, accompanied by fresh fruit slices served with native chili-salt seasoning.

reviews.author: Maria Santos
reviews.comment: The rambutan and mango groves are magical! Mang Juan's family welcomed us with fresh buko and hot kapeng barako. Picking sweet oranges straight from the trees was unforgettable for our kids!

reviews.author: Engr. Carlo Reyes
reviews.comment: Over 50,000 sunflowers in full bloom! The stingless bees are so gentle, and tasting fresh honey squeezed straight from the comb is an experience you won't get in the city.

reviews.author: Jasmine Siddiqui
reviews.comment: The view of Taal Lake while roasting fresh cacao beans into pure Batangas tablea is pure therapeutic bliss. Highly recommended!

reviews.author: Gabriel Mendoza
reviews.comment: The organic Ampalaya and Baguio Romaine delivered straight to our doorstep in Quezon City were crisp and garden-fresh. True farm-to-table quality.

faqs.question: How do I book a farm tour or fruit picking?
faqs.answer: Create a free tourist account, then open Explore Tours or Fruit Picking. Choose a date and available time slot, then pay at the farm. Your ticket appears under My Bookings.

faqs.question: Can I look around without an account?
faqs.answer: Yes. The opening page shows every farm, product and orchard with photos and full descriptions. You only need to log in to book, buy produce or leave a review.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: For farm product orders, customers can use Cash on Delivery (COD), where available. For tour bookings, payment is made directly at the farm through Pay at the Farm.

faqs.question: Can I change or cancel a booking?
faqs.answer: Open My Bookings to reschedule or cancel. One day before your visit we also ask you to confirm whether you will attend.

faqs.question: How long does produce delivery take?
faqs.answer: Most orders arrive within 1-2 days. Contact the farm through the details on its profile for an order update.

faqs.question: How do I change my profile photo?
faqs.answer: Click your name or photo at the top right, then choose Change Photo.

faqs.question: I'm a farmer. How do I list my farm?
faqs.answer: Sign up and choose Farmer. You can then add your story, photos, tours, fruit-picking experiences, produce, guides and time slots from your farmer profile.

faqs.question: Who do I contact for help?
faqs.answer: Use Forgot password on the login page for account issues, or contact the farm directly using the details on its profile.
